 Updated: 1:54 PM EDT Oct 29, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Alex Suckow Digital Media Manager LOUISVILLE, Ky. — Voting is officially underway for all registered Kentucky voters.
 The state's no-excuse early voting runs Thursday through Saturday. 
 Advertisement Not every precinct offers it, but there's at least one location in each of Kentucky's 120 counties.
 Louisville has 25. One of those is a new drive-thru voting option at the Kentucky Expo Center.
 >> FIND A LOCATION HERE 
 What you need : A valid photo ID.
 If you miss early voting, Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3. This is the only day there will be federal election monitors in Louisville and Lexington.
